# toQrEcc

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

Resolves a [`QrEccInput`](qr-ecc-input.md) to the [`QrEcc`](qr-ecc.md) value. A value that is already an enumeration value is returned unchanged.

Import from `@bonniepdf/core`.

```typescript
toQrEcc(input: QrEcc | QrEccToken): QrEcc
```
